decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ Event already represents that badges are awarded on-chain at referral milestones; no additional cross-Requirement change is necessary.
The milestone list beginning at 2 may supersede the earlier First Referral badge, but the source does not explicitly remove that catalog entry and could merely document a subset of badge milestones.
Changing badge award milestones and recording does not alter the mint-number referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing methods, or display surfaces.
The metadata Requirement already requires permanent badges to be visible, and the source does not change that visibility requirement or its other metadata fields.
Badge award milestones do not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or earning limit.
Badge award rules are independent of prize winner selection, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, and on-chain verification.
The source changes how badges are earned, not the existing rule that earned badges transfer with the NFT on resale.
Badge milestones do not affect mint price, founder allocation, referral commission allocation, or prize-pool destinations.
The badge award modification does not change Big Block prize amounts, draw triggers, ticket eligibility, resets, or pool funding.
The badge award modification does not change Small Block prize amounts, draw frequency, ticket eligibility, resets, or pool funding.
Badge award milestones do not alter the manual one-click prize claim flow or its Winners-page location.
Badge award rules do not alter whether secondary royalties are enforced or their flat $10 amount.
